summary.text: Daquan Neal is the Democratic candidate for the Ohio House of Representatives, District 39, in the November 3, 2026 general election; he defeated Mike Stevens in the May 5, 2026 Democratic primary.
Ballotpedia's race overview says his work experience includes working as a legislative aide in the Ohio House and as a page in the Ohio Senate.
